name: implement-reproxy-mvp
title: Implement reproxy MVP (Go)
description: Implement the lightweight HTTP retry reverse proxy MVP in Go per the TEAM B audit report and ADR-0001: path-parsed dynamic upstream, query-driven per-request retry policy (status+network channels, exponential backoff with full jitter, Retry-After honored), body capture/replay with cap+downgrade, commit-point boundary, SSE streaming, 7-layer SSRF defense, X-Retry-* observability, server config caps. Zero external dependencies.
